newsitem.title: GERMANY: RWE 96/97 oper profit to improve - paper.
newsitem.headline: RWE 96/97 oper profit to improve - paper.

text.p: German utility RWE AG expects operating profit to continue to improve in 1996/97 and said group net profit in the first quarter of 1996/97 increased to 180 million marks, up 2.3 percent, a German newspaper said.

A report in the Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung also said that in the first quarter of this business year that investments totalled 1.05 billion marks, down from 1.23 billion during the same period last year.
The newspaper said the figures came from RWE's quarterly report which is due to be published on Monday.
